hero.purpose: Headline punchline on the landing and sign in, uppercase, in lime.

page-title.purpose: One-line page titles (Guardados, Alertas, Cuenta), no counter.

price.purpose: Every price, always lime, Spanish format.

wordmark.purpose: BUYCAR in text, MAP in lime.

lead.purpose: Subtitle under a headline, text-muted, 560px at most.

body.purpose: Running text and fields (16px, no iOS zoom).

overline.purpose: Search pill segment labels, uppercase, text-muted.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: What floats over content: the map preview, the toast and an open select list.

shadows.name: shadow-pin-active
shadows.purpose: Halo of the active price pin; no other pin has a shadow.

shadows.name: shadow-current
shadows.purpose: Ring around the header avatar while on Cuenta (desktop).

shadows.name: shadow-current-sm
shadows.purpose: Ring around the header avatar while on Cuenta (phone).

focus.purpose: Visible keyboard focus on every primitive.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: What the screen is for: one per task, a lime pill with on-lime text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--lime); color: var(--on-lime); font-family: "Rethink Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter action: 1px line border, text colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-family: "Rethink Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Undo Ghost Button
components.description: Undo without drama: text only, turns danger on hover and focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-family: "Rethink Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { color: var(--danger); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Toggle Chip
components.description: Quick filter: pressed is a violet fill at weight 800, unpressed a line border at 600.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 9px 16px; margin-right: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-family: "Rethink Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--violet); background: var(--violet); color: var(--on-violet); font-weight: 800; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A 52px field on bg with a line border that turns lime on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-field); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: "Rethink Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--lime); outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Account blocks and sign-in forms: surface, line border, radius-card.
components.html:
Seguridad

Verificación en dos pasos desactivada.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-card); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-family: "Rethink Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Unbounded, "Arial Black", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-body { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Source Badge
components.description: The listing's source over its photo, identical for every marketplace.
components.css: .ds-source-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--scrim); color: var(--text); font-family: "Rethink Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; }

components.name: Price Pin
components.description: Each car on the map; the active one turns lime with its halo.
components.css: .ds-pin { padding: 7px 13px; margin-right: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-family: "Rethink Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pin-active { border-color: var(--lime); background: var(--lime); color: var(--on-lime); font-weight: 800; box-shadow: var(--shadow-pin-active); } .ds-pin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
BuyCarMap 2.0 is black, cheeky and clean: almost everything on screen is near-black `bg` and `surface`, two complementary inks carry every meaning (lime for what you are doing or looking at now, violet for what is yours), and the headlines shout in uppercase like a mate who knows cars. The visual source of truth is [`docs/design/`](docs/design/README.md) — the screens and the UI Kit in `docs/design/canvas/`, the brand book and tokens in [`docs/design/system/`](docs/design/system/README.md) — viewed in the Claude Design project [BuyCarMap 2.0](https://claude.ai/design/p/838f9ee3-0bcc-4990-8c5a-5a685806db48). This file summarises that system for whoever builds a screen; where the two disagree, the design wins and this file is corrected.

There is one theme, dark, and no theme choice anywhere. The tokens in the frontmatter are exactly `docs/design/system/tokens.json`, and `app/globals.css` defines them under the same names (`--bg`, `--surface`, `--lime`, `--radius-pill`, `--shadow-float`…). The map is dark and minimal, controls are pills, and depth comes from tone and 1px lines rather than shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only: `bg` and `surface` make up about 95 % of any screen.
Two accents with fixed jobs — lime is "now", violet is "yours" — plus `danger` for the irreversible.
Unbounded in uppercase for display, Rethink Sans for everything else.
Everything you press is a pill (`radius-pill`).
Flat by default: three shadow roles, each for one job.

rules.name: The Lime-Is-Now Rule
rules.body: Lime marks only what you are doing or looking at now. Never running text, never decorative borders, never large backgrounds.

rules.name: The Violet-Is-Yours Rule
rules.body: Violet marks what belongs to the user and selected states. Quick test: lime = what you do or see now; violet = yours.

rules.name: The No-Brand-Colours Rule
rules.body: Wallapop, coches.net and Milanuncios get no colour of their own: the source is a dark badge with its name as text.

rules.name: The Tall-Caps Rule
rules.body: Multi-line Unbounded headlines never go below line-height 1.04 (1.06 on a phone) and never below -0.01em: the accents of Á, Í, Ó collide otherwise. A single line may use 0.9. Break lines with sense — never one word alone on a line (`text-wrap: balance`).

rules.name: The Figures-Line-Up Rule
rules.body: Prices are Unbounded; figures compared down a column use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` in Rethink Sans. Any leftover `font-mono` class resolves to the sans family.

rules.name: The Only-What-Floats Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the piece floats above the page or is the active pin. Nothing at rest carries one.

rules.name: The Email-Is-Its-Own-World Rule
rules.body: Nothing under `emails/` references an app token or Tailwind class. Every value there is a literal, chosen to read correctly in a mail client that has none of the app's CSS.

dos: **Do** keep `bg` and `surface` as the bulk of every screen, and use `text` and `text-muted` for text.
**Do** use lime only for what is happening now, with `on-lime` on top, and violet only for what is yours, with `on-violet` on top.
**Do** mark state with more than colour: a pressed chip changes fill and weight; the active pin changes fill, size and halo.
**Do** set display type in Unbounded uppercase and everything else in Rethink Sans.
**Do** make every pressable thing a pill and keep a 44px minimum target on a phone.
**Do** use Lucide icons at 2px stroke in the colour of the surrounding text.
**Do** format prices, mileage and dates through `lib/format.ts` (FRONT-11): `14.500 €`, `95.000 km`.
donts: **Don't** put lime on running text, decorative borders or large backgrounds.
**Don't** use pure white or pure black inside the app.
**Don't** colour a source by its marketplace brand.
**Don't** add a shadow outside the three roles in Elevation & Depth.
**Don't** add a theme switch: the product has one dark theme.
**Don't** put an icon above an empty-state headline, or use emoji.
**Don't** write «Bienvenido a…», «Descubre…» or invented figures; the voice rules are in `docs/design/system/README.md`.
